mechanism: RAG knowledge base over multi-source data for database interaction, with fine-tuned text-to-SQL and feedback-based adaptive learning
evidence_scope: DB-GPT builds a pipeline that ingests multi-source unstructured data (PDF's, web pages, images, etc) into inter- mediate representations, stores them in a structured knowledge base, retrieves the most relevant pieces
evidence_role: we present DB-GPT, a revolutionary and production- ready project that integrates LLMs with traditional database systems to enhance user experience and accessibility.
